summary: PubConnect Phase 1 full backend + frontend regression. Created pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_pubconnect.py with 36 tests covering auth, dashboard, customers (incl. duplicate mobile 409), ledger safety (deposit/redeem/overdraft rejection, refund rules + cap, reversal rules + double-reversal block, adjustment with negative-balance guard & exceptional flag), offer matching + usage caps + times_redeemed increment, offers CRUD + toggle, staff rules (manager cannot create owner, cannot deactivate self), audit ACCESS_DENIED, permissions 403 matrix for OWNER/MANAGER/BAR_STAFF, pub update. ALL 36 TESTS PASS. Frontend verified via Playwright: OWNER login works and sees full sidebar; BAR_STAFF sees only Dashboard/Fast Service/Customers/Transactions and is redirected away from /offers; Fast Service workflow deposit of £20 to Harry Collins auto-matched Happy Hour offer and showed +£1 bonus in dashboard, confirmation modal and success screen worked; transaction detail drawer opens with linked original. No blocking issues found.

issues: Customer code appears concatenated to the name text in DOM (TEST_LimCC6F637) because the small code line sits below the name without a semantic separator; copy-paste UX minor only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 867 lines - consider splitting by resource (auth/customers/ledger/offers/staff/pub/audit) for maintainability.
CORS allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' fallback is invalid per spec; set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly in production.
seed_demo is called on every startup; make sure it is idempotent (looks ok but worth confirming for OWNER password updates per playbook).
wallet balance derivation uses full aggregation on every call - acceptable for Phase 1 but could be cached/materialized once volumes grow.
Deposit matching: when offer_id supplied but times_redeemed cap or per-customer cap is reached, error says 'expired, limit reached, or amount mismatch' - good; just verify UI surfaces it.
